reason: I already pay for Cursor and it shares context inside the editor; I don't want another local daemon running just to switch between agents. The first five humans are free, so price isn't the issue — I just don't add tools I don't feel a pull to use.
objection: Cursor/Copilot already do context sharing within their own editor, so Loom feels like a duplicate layer I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: If context genuinely broke between Cursor and Codex on a real task and I felt the pain myself.
